item.title: What you need to know about the 7 May elections in England, Scotland and Wales
item.description: Millions will vote in parliamentary elections in Scotland and Wales, and local elections in England.

item.title: Greece examines mystery naval drone found in Ionian Sea
item.description: Greek media say the drone, which reportedly had explosives, could be either Ukrainian or linked to the Russia-Ukraine war.

item.title: Australian by-election a litmus test for right-wing One Nation Party
item.description: Victory for the populist party in Farrer, New South Wales, would see One Nation's first MP elected to Australia's national parliament.

item.title: White House calls Mark Hamill 'sick' after actor's Trump grave post
item.description: The Star Wars actor apologised and deleted the post, which contained an AI image of the president in a shallow grave.
